help.title: Help
help.tourHint: Questions, a tour and a demo project

invite.title: New in the Studio: a 3-minute introduction
invite.body: A short tour and a demo project: build, AI agent, comments and git on an example, with no risk to your projects.

restart.title: Introduction to the Studio
restart.body: Questions, an interface tour and a demo project in a sandbox. You can take it again at any time.

intro.title: Meet HSE Studio
intro.body: The Studio helps you format a coursework, thesis or report with your university's template: you write the text, the Studio builds a compliant PDF, the AI agent checks it, your supervisor leaves comments, and everything is kept in git.
intro.plan: Answer a couple of questions and we will show you the interface and walk through a demo project. About 3 minutes, nothing real is created.

work.title: What are you working on?
work.other: Something else or not sure yet

tour.skippedToast: You can take the introduction later from the Help menu in the top right corner.

homeNewProject.title: New project
homeNewProject.body: Start a work from your university's template here: the wizard asks for the topic, authors and supervisor and builds a ready skeleton.

homeSearch.title: Your projects
homeSearch.body: Your projects, search (press /) and filters. Pinned projects stay on top.

homeAgent.title: AI agent
homeAgent.body: The agent answers questions about the Studio, and inside a project it edits and checks the text. It is set up in Settings if the administrator allows AI.

homeSettings.title: Settings
homeSettings.body: Theme, language, the profile that signs your versions, git access and AI providers.

homeAdmin.title: Administration
homeAdmin.body: The account menu leads to the admin area: people and invitations, build runners, AI providers, quotas and backups.

homeHelp.title: Help
homeHelp.body: Restart the introduction or open the demo project here at any time. Next, let's see the work on an example.

demoIntro.title: Demo project
demoIntro.body: This is a sandbox: the project lives only in this tab, the build, AI and git are simulated. Click anything, nothing will break.

demoCreate.title: Create a project from a template
demoCreate.body: The real wizard asks for more; here one click is enough.

demoFiles.title: Project files
demoFiles.body: On the left are the files: the main document main.tex, the bibliography and images. The Studio keeps the structure in line with the template.

demoLatex.title: A bit about LaTeX
demoLatex.body: The text uses markup: \section{…} is a section heading, \title{…} is the topic on the title page. The Studio handles the formatting rules, no need to think about fonts and margins.

demoEdit.title: Enter your topic
demoEdit.body: Replace “Your thesis topic” in the \title line with your own topic or press the button below.

demoBuild.title: Build the PDF
demoBuild.body: The build turns the source into a PDF that meets the university's rules. On a server runners do it, locally Docker on your computer.

demoPreview.title: PDF preview
demoPreview.body: The document is visible right away. The topic you entered is already on the title page.

demoAgent.title: Ask the AI agent
demoAgent.body: The agent reads the project and can check the text or suggest an edit. Pick a request or press the button below.
demoAgent.body_supervisor: The agent helps supervisors too: it checks a student's text and drafts comments. Pick a request or press the button below.

demoReview.title: Comments
demoReview.body: Comments from the supervisor and the AI sit in the margin. Accept the edit and the comment is resolved.
demoReview.body_supervisor: This is how a student sees your comments. They answer with an edit, and you see what has been fixed.

demoGit.title: Git: history and sync
demoGit.body: Connect a repository and every saved version goes there as a commit. Press “Sync”.
demoGit.body_beginner: Git keeps the history of versions. You don't need any commands: the Studio commits and pushes for you, you press one button. Optional, but very useful.
demoGit.body_pro: Plain git: a remote over HTTPS or SSH, commits under your name, push and pull with conflict resolution in the interface.

demo.banner: Demo mode: the project exists only in this tab, nothing is sent to the server.
demo.previewEmpty: Build the project to see the PDF.

finish.title: Done! Now a real project
finish.body: You have walked the whole path: template, text, build, AI, comments and git. Start your own work, the wizard takes a couple of minutes.

build.local: Builds run on your computer in Docker.
build.available: Cloud builds are available on this server.
build.unavailable: Cloud builds are not available on this server right now: no runners are connected. You can already write, work with comments and git; build the PDF in the local Studio on your computer, and the administrator will enable cloud builds.
build.unknown: If the PDF build does not start, the server has no runners yet: tell your administrator. Text, comments and git work without it.

finish.admin: As an administrator, start in the admin area: connect a build runner and an AI provider, then invite people.
finish.supervisor: Students will invite you to their projects, invitations appear in your Inbox.
